description:
V00.75 SPI core for the Security Event Bus: sealed SecurityEvent
    hierarchy, signed SecurityEventEnvelope, EventBus API,
    Publish/Consume pipelines, and the SPI surfaces for
    SignatureAlgorithm, PayloadCodec, KeyManagement, ReplayStore,
    SequenceStore, ProducerPolicy, EventStore, DeadLetterStore.
    Framework-neutral — no Vaadin, no REST framework, no Eclipse Store.
    Persistent stores live in jCustos-events-persistence-eclipsestore;
    REST/SSE bridge lives in jCustos-events-rest.
